heading: Europe-wide paid AI/ML research opportunities for international Master's students
scope: European universities and research institutes; paid employment, stipend or funded living costs; all AI/ML fields. Program admission and visa rules always prevail.
safety: Public program facts only. No applicant identity, application status, documents or private notes. A source-backed candidate is not an application or eligibility approval.

rules.sourcePrecedence: official organizer pages only; recheck before relying on a cutoff
rules.eligibility: conditional until graduation date, nationality, current enrolment and project rules are checked

records.name: CaCTüS Tübingen 2027
records.host: Max Planck Institutes / Tübingen AI Center
records.funding: Fully funded for 3 months; stipend plus travel and accommodation support
records.eligibilityDetail: Open to enrolled or recent BSc/MSc students worldwide; especially encourages candidates facing barriers and those from lower/middle income countries.
records.action: Prepare CV, academic evidence and interest statement now.

records.name: Summer@EPFL
records.host: EPFL School of Computer and Communication Sciences
records.deadlineNote: Date derived from official recurring rule: Sunday nearest 1 December; check 2027 application portal
records.funding: CHF 1,800 per month + eligible travel reimbursement
records.eligibilityDetail: Open worldwide to BSc/BTech/MSc/MTech in CS/CE/Telecom/EE; MUST remain enrolled during summer fellowship.
records.action: Confirm graduation date and prepare CV, transcripts, motivation letter.

records.name: CISPA Summer Research 2027
records.deadlineNote: Search-indexed 2027 call lists 30 Nov 2026 AoE; official page cache also showed 2026, reconfirm live portal
records.eligibilityDetail: MSc/BTech etc in CS-related field; must remain student during internship; international applicants welcome; verify 2027 round.
records.action: Reopen the 2027 application portal, verify it is live, then prepare application.

records.name: ETH Student Summer Research Fellowship 2027
records.deadlineNote: 16 Dec 2026 at 13:00 CET, per official SiROP listing
records.funding: CHF 4,000 total for 2 months; travel and visa support
records.eligibilityDetail: Crucial: expected graduation earliest in spring semester 2028 (year AFTER the 2027 fellowship); open worldwide except ETH students.
records.action: Verify MSc graduation year first; if 2028+, prepare CV, transcript and letter.

records.name: RC Trust Research Internship 2027
records.host: Research Center Trustworthy Data Science and Security
records.funding: Living, housing and travel costs fully covered
records.eligibilityDetail: Worldwide applicants; primarily Master's and PhD level; strong CS/statistics/security background. Apply through online form once available; email alone is not accepted.
records.action: Select specific research group and watch for online application form.

records.name: AScI International Summer Research 2027
records.deadlineNote: 31 Jan 2027 at 23:59 UTC+2; applications open 7 Jan
records.eligibilityDetail: Open to Bachelor's and Master's students worldwide; paid employment in assigned research group. Specific projects published mid-December.
records.action: Review research projects when published in December; select up to three.

records.name: CERN openlab Summer Students 2027
records.deadlineNote: Call announced for November 2026; 2027 deadline not yet shown
records.funding: CHF 94 per calendar day + travel allowance and health coverage
records.eligibilityDetail: Master's students with strong computing profile; 3 years full-time university study by summer; applicants of any nationality. Confirm graduation/enrolment details in 2027 FAQ.
records.action: Monitor official career opening; prepare CV, transcripts and academic reference.

records.name: ISTA Scientific Internship
records.host: Institute of Science and Technology Austria
records.deadlineNote: Rolling; recommend contact ≥4 months before preferred start
records.funding: At least €1,583 gross/month salary, contingent on group funding and approval
records.eligibilityDetail: Current or recent bachelor's/master's degree in sciences/CS/math; sponsor group and two-month minimum. Cannot simultaneously be employed/funded elsewhere.
records.action: Identify matching groups and send tailored expressions of interest; verify faculty funding.

records.name: Max Planck Computer Science Internships
records.host: MPI Informatics / Software Systems / Security and Privacy
records.deadlineNote: Summer 2027 central deadline was 1 Nov 2026 (passed); non-summer starts rolling ≥5 months ahead
records.funding: Stipend + housing + round-trip travel costs fully covered
records.eligibilityDetail: Open worldwide to strong bachelor's/master's/doctoral CS students; research placement dependent on group capacity.
records.action: Consider September–December 2027 non-summer internship; submit ≥5 months ahead.

records.name: France Excellence Charpak Summer Training
records.host: French Institute in India / French host labs
records.deadlineNote: 2027 deadline not yet verified; host invitation required before scholarship application
records.funding: €700/month for at most 2 months; visa fee waiver, NOT travel/accommodation
records.eligibilityDetail: Restricted to Indian nationals resident in India, ≤30 years, enrolled in Indian bachelor's/master's; requires French lab invitation. Partial cost coverage only.
records.action: Build list of 5 French labs and seek invitation; verify citizenship, age, costs and 2027 call.

records.name: Designing Responsible NLP 2027 Studentships
records.deadlineNote: Stage 1 mandatory deadline, 23:59 GMT; separate invited Stage 2 in January
records.funding: Tuition covered + standard UKRI stipend for overseas applicants; home-only enhanced rate
records.eligibilityDetail: International applicants considered; requires suitability for PhD training rather than a summer internship. Admission and graduation timeline must be checked.
records.action: Consider only if a paid PhD/research training move is desired.

records.name: MPI Infection Biology International Summer Internship 2027
records.host: Max Planck Institute for Infection Biology
records.deadlineNote: 2027 cycle known; confirm deadline and availability of ML-relevant host projects
records.funding: €1,400 monthly stipend + accommodation and travel support
records.eligibilityDetail: International bachelor's/master's students. Projects primarily infection biology; only pursue if relevant computational/AI project exists.
records.action: Check whether 2027 host projects include computational biology or ML.
